verdict.rationale: The only first-party command-line surface is the documented `swift run -c release SillHost`, which runs the Sill host from the command line and accepts a `--synthetic` flag. It is a from-source developer run path, not a packaged CLI for controlling Sill. Homebrew install and shasum verification are host-platform tools and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a packaged official CLI binary, documented commands for controlling sessions or windows, scripting or agent-oriented usage docs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: `swift run -c release SillHost` runs the same host on the command line... With `--synthetic` it streams a test pattern with no Screen Recording needed.
